    found: Annotated[list[str], operator.add]
b = StateGraph(S)
b.add_node("rank", lambda s: {"found": ["rank"]})
b.add_edge(START, "rank")
b.add_edge("rank", END)
b.add_node("search", lambda s: {"found": ["search"]})
b.add_edge(START, "search")
b.add_edge("search", END)
try:
    out = b.compile().invoke({"found": []})
    print(sorted(out["found"]))
except Exception as e:
    print(type(e).__name__)

    found: Annotated[list[str], operator.add]
b = StateGraph(S)
b.add_node("fetch", lambda s: {"found": ["fetch"]})
b.add_edge(START, "fetch")
b.add_edge("fetch", END)
b.add_node("write", lambda s: {"found": ["write"]})
b.add_edge(START, "write")
b.add_edge("write", END)
try:
    out = b.compile().invoke({"found": []})
    print(sorted(out["found"]))
except Exception as e:
    print(type(e).__name__)

from langgraph.errors import GraphRecursionError
class S(TypedDict):
    n: int
b = StateGraph(S)
b.add_node("step", lambda s: {"n": s["n"] + 1})
b.add_edge(START, "step")
b.add_conditional_edges("step", lambda s: "step" if s["n"] < 7 else END)
try:
    print(b.compile().invoke({"n": 0}, {"recursion_limit": 12})["n"])
except GraphRecursionError:
    print("GraphRecursionError")

    v: int
    path: Annotated[list[str], operator.add]

class S(TypedDict):
    v: int
    path: Annotated[list[str], operator.add]
def route(s):
    if s["v"] < 8:
        return "low"
    if s["v"] < 24:
        return "mid"
    return "high"
b = StateGraph(S)
for n in ["low", "mid", "high"]:
    b.add_node(n, lambda s, n=n: {"path": [n]})
    b.add_edge(n, END)
b.add_node("classify", lambda s: {"path": ["classify"]})
b.add_edge(START, "classify")
b.add_conditional_edges("classify", route)
print(b.compile().invoke({"v": 14, "path": []})["path"])

from langgraph.types import Send
class S(TypedDict):
    topics: list[str]
    out: Annotated[list[str], operator.add]
def fan_out(s):
    return [Send("work", {"t": t}) for t in s["topics"]]
b = StateGraph(S)
b.add_node("work", lambda p: {"out": [p["t"].upper()]})
b.add_conditional_edges(START, fan_out, ["work"])
b.add_edge("work", END)
out = b.compile().invoke({"topics": ['c', 'a'], "out": []})
print(len(out["out"]), sorted(out["out"])[0])
